title: Chamber graph center
headline: Find the most central chamber
question: Black lines are walls, and connected white areas are chambers. Two chambers are neighbors only when they share a black wall segment; touching at a corner does not count. For counting distance, one step crosses one shared wall into a neighboring chamber. Which colored dot is in the chamber whose farthest chamber is the fewest steps away? Answer orange, green, or purple.

forward.code:
def analytic_gold(scene: dict) -> str:
    layout = scene["layout"]
    markers = scene["markers"]
    graph = _adjacency(layout)
    eccentricities = _eccentricities(graph)
    values = {color: eccentricities[layout[r][c]] for color, (r, c) in markers.items()}
    best = min(values.values())
    matches = [color for color, value in values.items() if value == best]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        return "abstain"
    return matches[0]
